category: Svelte 5 diff component — diff-match-patch-based text comparison with drop-in rendering, semantic/efficiency cleanup, and 'expected patterns'

repo_triage._comment: Public repo — GITHUB_TOKEN raises rate limits; public-read fallback works without it. Surfaces open PRs/issues NOT opened by github_handle, and threads awaiting your reply since the previous last_run.

self_features: Drop-in Svelte 5 component (renders the diff for you, not just an algorithm)
diff-match-patch engine (via diff-match-patch-ts) with a configurable timeout guard for large texts
Character, whole-word, and whole-line diff modes via diffMode
Configurable character-mode cleanup — semantic and efficiency modes
Optional CodeDiff component via @humanspeak/svelte-diff/code — full-source syntax highlighting with a caller-supplied TanStack highlighter and selectively registered languages
Expected patterns — mark dynamic regions (dates, names) as 'expected' instead of diffs
Customizable rendering via CSS classes OR Svelte snippets
non_goals: Side-by-side file view / git patch (files, hunks, headers) awareness — that's diff2html's domain
Standalone patch create / apply + fuzzy match utilities — that's the raw diff-match-patch library
Framework-agnostic use — this is a Svelte component, not a generic JS lib

deferred_features.status: open enhancement; user use cases guide scope and priority
deferred_features.reason: Word mode covers common prose reviews. Keep sentence comparison open for users who need whole-sentence highlighting, with examples and language requirements guiding the design rather than declaring it a non-goal.

deferred_features.status: open enhancement; user use cases guide scope and priority
deferred_features.reason: Line mode covers common formatted configuration reviews. Keep JSON comparison open for users who need formatting-independent results, property-order handling, or nested change paths. User examples should determine whether canonicalized text comparison or a structural approach is warranted.

competitors.note: jsdiff — the ubiquitous framework-agnostic JS diff algorithm; we render, it doesn't
Google's original algorithm this space is built on; unmaintained, no rendering, no Svelte
git-diff → HTML (side-by-side/line view); different shape (file diffs) but overlaps on 'diff viewer' search
